name: Method C Same-Mesh Transfer Diagnostic Formulation and Offline Comparison
description: Formulation, offline execution, and verification of Method C same-mesh transfer diagnostic (Configurations A, B0, B1, and C) on the accepted C5 donor state (Job 1419566 Checkpoint 03, 12,996 elements) to decouple transfer/reinitialization perturbations from receiver-mesh changes. Strictly 0 PBS submissions authorized.

governance.directive: OPTION 1 — ACCEPT F1618 DATACHECK QUALIFICATION AND PRIORITIZE THE SAME-MESH TRANSFER DIAGNOSTIC

A.name: Original-State Control
A.description: Accepted C5 Checkpoint 03 on original 12,996-element discretization (Job 1419566) without remapping

B0.name: Exact-Copy Control
B0.description: Same 12,996-element C5 mesh with exact matching nodal and Gauss-point states carried over directly without spatial interpolation
B0.purpose: Establish whether restarting/reinitializing an otherwise unchanged state introduces solver/input deck discrepancies

B1.name: Actual Transfer-Pipeline Control
B1.description: Same 12,996-element C5 mesh, but processed through the production spatial-transfer and GP history reconstruction workflow
B1.purpose: Isolate the intrinsic numerical perturbation (smoothing, GP element averaging, lower bounds) introduced by the transfer operator itself

C.name: Nonmatching-Mesh Comparison
C.description: Production C5-to-C6 nonmatching transferred state on 15,252-element C6 receiver mesh and authentic R9/R10 evidence
C.purpose: Provide reference baseline of the coupled re-equilibration dynamics observed on changed discretization

investigation_targets: Maximum and RMS differences in nodal damage d and displacement u between B0, B1, and C
Maximum and RMS differences in Gauss-point driving history H, including crack-tip localization
Exact donor/receiver node and element correspondences
Explicit test of GP history element averaging (scripts/remeshing/c5_to_c6_adaptive_integration.py mechanism)
Crack seam node duplication and topological isolation
Initial fixed-point residuals and KKT complementarity before re-equilibration
Differences between applied damage increments and intrinsic raw PDAS residuals
deliverables: Controlled same-mesh transfer diagnostic execution script
Comprehensive comparison dataset and quantitative evaluation metrics
Unit and contract regression tests for same-mesh transfer parity
Diagnostic evaluation report and machine-readable JSON summary
